# Tawheed Malkat (توحيد ملقط)

> Senior product designer (UI/UX) and informatics engineer from Damascus, Syria. 4+ years designing web and mobile products with teams in Syria, Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Germany. The site is in Arabic and English.

## Projects
- [Schola — Education Platform | UX/UI Case Study](https://nouraldeentofi.github.io/tawheed-malkat/project-schola.html): A UX/UI case study for an education platform.
- [AviGate — Digital Poultry Industry Ecosystem](https://nouraldeentofi.github.io/tawheed-malkat/project-avigate.html): A digital ecosystem for the poultry industry.
- [Luxury Real Estate Platform | UX/UI Case Study](https://nouraldeentofi.github.io/tawheed-malkat/project-luxury-real-estate.html): A UX/UI case study for a luxury real-estate platform.
- [Geekings Brand Guidelines.](https://nouraldeentofi.github.io/tawheed-malkat/project-geekings-brand.html): Brand guidelines for Geekings.
- [Express Syria | Shipping Platform for Parcel Delivery](https://nouraldeentofi.github.io/tawheed-malkat/project-express-syria.html): A shipping platform for parcel delivery.
- [Software Company Landing Page | UI/UX Design](https://nouraldeentofi.github.io/tawheed-malkat/project-software-landing.html): UI/UX design for a software company landing page.
- [Instructional Design | PILearn](https://nouraldeentofi.github.io/tawheed-malkat/project-pilearn.html): Instructional design for PILearn.
- [Cosmetic Clinic Design](https://nouraldeentofi.github.io/tawheed-malkat/project-cosmetic-clinic.html): Design for a cosmetic clinic.
